title: Setup: a last rank spelling eight points is a position of no board
rationale: The last rank spells eight points on a board of nine. The engine's structural validator checks a rank's width only where a '/' follows it, so it never checks this one and accepts the FEN; the predicate reads the frozen encoding, refuses it, and reaches no setup rule. That strictness is load-bearing rather than fussy — it is what keeps the predicate judging the same board the engine plays — and this is what pins it: a parse loosened toward the validator would start answering about a board with a rank missing a point.
